record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare TEA_TIME: Sinistea (1 star) and Polteageist (2 stars); both maxPP 100, range 2, no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: requiresTarget is overridden to false, so the moving state casts it whenever pp >= maxPP and canCast, with target null, without walking to an enemy. canCritByDefault stays false: crit is rolled only with the ABILITY_CRIT effect.

record.summary: After spending PP (a visual ability broadcast is sent at each ally cell), every unit of the caster's team on the board (the caster included) is visited in row-major order (rows y outer, columns x inner). For each one: (1) handleHeal(raw 15/30/60/120 by caster stars, caster, apBoost 1, crit) - the requested amount scales with the caster's AP, with critPower only if the cast crit (ability crit only), and then goes through handleHeal's branches: a wounded ally takes the wound branch (no HP; with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player it requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), ally, apBoost 1, crit)); otherwise an ally with status.protect gets nothing (Rune Protect alone does not block); otherwise the modifiers (x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH), rounding and the missing-HP cap apply, and a GRASS-synergy ally's overheal requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). (2) Then, in the same iteration, the FIRST berry found among that ally's held items (in item order; Berries = 20 ordinary + Nanab, Golden Razz, Golden Nanab, Golden Pinap; Berry Juice is not in the list) is eaten with eatBerry(berry): its own heal (usually 50, 100 for Pecha and Sitrus, 50% of max HP at least 50 for Aguav and the golden berries) uses apBoost 0 and no crit, so it is NOT AP-scaled, still goes through handleHeal's wound/protect/modifier/cap branches (the berry is consumed even if the heal gives nothing), and the berry's extra effect and the post-berry effects (Glutton, Berry Juice shield, Overgrow) apply. At most one berry per ally per cast.

targeting.who: all allies on the board (same team), including the caster; no range or adjacency
targeting.note: Cells are tested with tg && pokemon.team == tg.team. Enemies and empty cells are skipped. The cast does not use a target (null may be passed).

geometry.shape: whole board, no geometry; scan order is row-major (y outer loop, x inner loop), which fixes the order in which allies are healed and eat berries

effects.target: every allied unit on the board, caster included
effects.scaling: requested = table value (raw, per ally). applied by PokemonState.handleHeal with apBoost 1: x(1 + AP/100) of the caster; x critPower if the cast crit; x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED (e.g. from an earlier Sitrus); x0.5 when burning; x0.5 when enraged; x1.2 under ZENITH weather; rounded; capped to the ally's missing HP (healReceived); the rest is overheal, which on a GRASS-synergy ally requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) (a request: addMaxHP's own helpers decide the final change).
effects.resolution: requested (raw) -> applied (after modifiers and rounding) -> healReceived (after the missing-HP cap; only healReceived raises hp and counts into the caster's healDone). Wound branch comes first: a wounded ally gets 0 HP and returns before the Protect test; with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone held by that ally's player the branch requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x raw requested heal), ally, apBoost 1, crit) (the ally is the shield's caster, so its own AP and critPower scale the request; Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down is applied by the entity addShield helper). status.protect on an unwounded ally gives 0; status.runeProtect is not read. A dead ally (hp <= 0) gets 0. Per-star: 1 star = 15, 2 stars = 30 raw.

effects.target: each allied unit that holds at least one berry (first berry in item order only)

declaredRaw.note: eatBerry(berry) with default arguments: no stealedFrom, healToShield false, apScaling 0, crit false

effects.scaling: The berry heal is handleHeal(val, ally, 0, false): not AP-scaled and never crit-scaled, but it is subject to the same wound/protect/modifier/rounding/cap/Grass-overheal steps as the tea heal. Typical values: 50 for most berries, 100 for Pecha and Sitrus, min(50)(0.5 x maxHP) i.e. at least 50 for Aguav and the golden berries (Golden Razz/Nanab/Pinap).
effects.resolution: Per berry (eat-switch): Aguav confusion 3000 ms; Apicot +20 SPE_DEF; Aspear unfreeze + freeze immunity + 15 speed; Cheri heals paralysis + immunity + 10 attack; Chesto clears sleep + immunity + 50 AP; Ganlon +20 DEF; Jaboca spike armor 10000 ms; Lansat +50 crit chance; Leppa +50 PP; Liechi +15 attack; Lum clears negative status and Rune Protect 5000 ms; Oran heal 50 then addShield(80, apBoost 0); Pecha heal 100 + poison reset + immunity; Persim heals confusion + immunity + 10 SPE_DEF; Petaya +80 AP; Rawst heals burn + immunity + 10 DEF; Rowap magic bounce 10000 ms; Salac +50 speed; Sitrus adds BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED THEN heals 100 (so its own heal is x1.3); Babiri heal 50 + protect 2000 ms; Nanab heal 50 + 1 gold (player, not ghost battle); Golden Nanab +5 gold; Golden Razz +6 free rolls; Golden Pinap +3 random sweets. Each stat/PP/shield amount is a REQUEST to the stat helpers (applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff x1.25 rounded down for positive changes of a Big Eater Belt holder; Twist Band only reverses negatives from enemies/environment); the applied change can differ. After the switch the berry is removed (removeItem(berry, true)); Glutton passive adds +10 HP stat; BERRY_JUICE effect adds a 100 shield; OVERGROW effect adds +50 AP.

statusEffects.effect: only through berries: confusion (Aguav), freeze/paralysis/sleep/burn/poison/confusion cures (Aspear, Cheri, Chesto, Rawst, Pecha, Persim), Lum clears negative status and sets Rune Protect; Babiri sets protect 2000 ms; Jaboca spike armor; Rowap magic bounce

shields.effect: Oran berry shield 80 (request, apBoost 0); Berry Juice effect shield 100; Blood Moon + Blood Stone wound-branch request

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; 60 and 120 are not reached at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None: every allied unit on the board is affected regardless of distance. The caster is included in both the heal and the berry step. A lone caster still heals and eats its own berry.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast re-reads current items: berries eaten earlier are gone (removeItem), so a later cast finds the next berry. Because the heal precedes the berry in each iteration, a Sitrus eaten this cast does not boost this cast's tea heal for that ally, but does boost later heals.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw heal 15/30 (1/2 stars) is the requested amount per ally; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor x status/weather modifiers, rounded; healReceived is capped by missing HP, so full-HP allies receive 0 HP from it (the whole amount is overheal). A wounded ally receives 0 HP from BOTH the tea heal and its berry heal (wound branch), but still eats and loses the berry and receives the berry's non-heal effects. Berry heals are a separate, non-AP-scaled amount.
